MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.

2. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.

3. When learning Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.

4. When learning Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.

5. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.

6. When learning Photography, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Photography.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.

7. When learning Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

10. When learning Introduction to Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Photography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Video Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.

2. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.

3. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.

4. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.

7. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

8. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

9. D — Information and Communication Technology

10. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.

11. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

12. D — CPU

15. (4 marks)
